description: Create a draft: work-in-progress content that is saved but never publishes. Requires platform or a non-empty platforms array; draft_planned_for is a planning date only and schedules nothing. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

draft_planned_for.description: ISO 8601 date/time for calendar placement (optional, does not schedule).

platform.description: Primary platform (e.g., "twitter", "instagram"). Provide `platform` or a non-empty `platforms` array — one of the two is required.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_create_draft
title: Create Draft
